description: Apply stored learning suggestions to an existing app and return the applied routes, suggested per-minute limit and learning-session metadata. Review gate_learn_suggestions first, then explicitly confirm; requires the project owner key or an admin member key. mode="extend" adds learned routes (default); "replace" removes existing routes before applying them. Both modes set the learned rate limit and keep the app key. Only learned suggestions can be applied: arbitrary routes or rate limits are not accepted, and this tool never starts learning.

admin_key.description: The project owner key (ga_...) or an accepted admin member key (gm_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

app.description: The app id (app_...) with stored learning suggestions

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation to apply the reviewed learning suggestions

mode.description: Extend existing routes (default), or replace them with learned routes; both set the suggested rate limit

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_update_app
title: Apply learned app routes and rate limit
